scenicChapters.title: Pyrenees Cols Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 6.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Pyrenees Cols Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1569 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

pyrenees-cols-route.story: A one-way ride of 249 km, Lourdes to Saint-Girons - roughly 3 h 25 in the saddle. It goes by way of Col du Tourmalet, Col d Aspin, Col de Peyresourde and Bagneres de Luchon. The highest point is about 2,100 m. Col du Tourmalet, Col d Aspin and Col de Peyresourde are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
